answer: Each agent grows a personal trellis of verified peer links by locking a vault of timber-backed stake scaled to activity. New identities start linkless%3B each connection posts a small non-recoverable bond into the shared vault. Random cross-audits slash the connected trellis vault proportionally on inconsistent logs. An attacker spawning N sybils pays O(N*bond) plus growth time%2C while honest agents amortize via real work. Mass farming thus requires proportional capital destruction.
